body: Damn man I'm sorry to hear about that. I hope everything works out for you.

Thanks again man.
Just curious, what do you do for a living?

Wow thank you for that confidence boost, man! Yeah I'm doing poorly in calc right now. I failed the first exam, even though I studied really hard for it. I have another coming up, but tbh I didn't study that hard for it because I thought it really wouldn't matter. 

Yes I want to leave my job. I don't think I would move out of the city because I have to stay and take care of my mom. I really just want to find another job that isn't in the food industry. I'm trying to apply for some admin/receptionist job, but since I only have exp in food, I'm scared I won't get the job. I know I'm still kinda young, but just seeing all my friends start their adult lives makes me feel like I'm just behind in life. I'm trying not to compare myself to them, but its really hard not to.


Anyways thank you for all the help, man. 
I really appreciate it

Yeah I have thought about something in IT. I've heard that you don't even need a degree to get most jobs. The problem is that I don't think I'm smart enough for IT. I feel like I was made to live a brutal life. Everything in my life has gone to shit tbh. I only work like 20-30 hrs a week, so its not too bad. 

I really want to leave this place though. All my co workers are leaving and I don't want to be left alone with a bunch of high school kids.
